items.source: RepresentationModelProcessor to add a profile link to the root resource to point to multiple forms of metadata.
items.translation: RepresentationModelProcessor 用于向根资源添加一个 profile 链接，以指向多种形式的元数据。

items.source: Dedicated resource type to represent the links pointing to collection resources exposed for repositories.
items.translation: 专用资源类型，用于表示指向为仓库公开的集合资源的链接。

items.source: Lists all repositories exported by creating a link list pointing to resources exposing the repositories.
items.translation: 列出所有通过创建指向暴露这些资源的链接列表而导出的仓库。
